disclaimer: Verify against official BIS document. Acceptable limit is preferred; permissible limit applies only in absence of alternate sources.

pH.name: pH
pH.action_on_breach: Inspect chemical dosing, buffer treatment, or check source contamination.

turbidity_NTU.name: Turbidity
turbidity_NTU.action_on_breach: Inspect filtration bed, flush line, check for pipe rupture or cross-contamination.

TDS_mgL.name: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS)
TDS_mgL.action_on_breach: Check source water blending ratio or reverse osmosis membrane integrity.

residual_chlorine_mgL.name: Free Residual Chlorine
residual_chlorine_mgL.action_on_breach: Increase booster chlorination at distributor reservoir or flush stagnation dead-ends.

total_coliform.name: Total Coliform Bacteria
total_coliform.action_on_breach: CRITICAL: Issue immediate boil water advisory and perform hyperchlorination.

e_coli.name: Escherichia coli (E. coli)
e_coli.action_on_breach: CRITICAL: Isolate branch immediately, alert health authorities, and issue public advisory.
